verdict.guard_found: No URL validation (no scheme, host, IP, or redirect checks) before axios.get at routes.js:15. The admin gate at routes.js:7-8 and 12 (requireAdmin via admin.use) is the only control, and it is authorization, not a closing guard.
verdict.reason: All trace lines match the file (routes.js:7-8, 12, 15, 16), but the source fails the attacker-control check: every request to the handler at routes.js:14 must pass requireAdmin (routes.js:8, 12) with req.session.role === "admin", so only an admin can set req.query.url, and nothing in this file shows a low-privilege user can reach or forge that role. This is an admin-only input, which the criteria exclude; it would flip to CONFIRMED only if session role could be attacker-set or the admin router were mounted without this gate (mount point not in the provided files).
